competences.description: Attacks the enemy to decrease the Defense for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to deal damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken. The target defeated by this attack cannot be revived during the battle.

effets.description: Prevents an enemy from being resurrected after being killed.

competences.description: Recovers your HP by 20% if you gain a turn while having 50% or below HP. Increases the damage by up to 100% according to your HP condition if you attack the enemy while having more than 50% HP. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Heal that affects only the monster who cast the skill
